summary: Kamala Harris ke pita Donald Harris Jamaica se 1964 mein America aaye the, aur unki maa Shyamalan Gopalan ek Bharatiya-American thi. 1965 mein apravartan aur rashtriyata kanoon parit hua, jis se Bharatiya logon ki sankhya America mein badhi, 2000 mein 19,00,000 se 2015 tak 39,82,000 tak pahunch gayi. Pew Research ke mutabik, 40 percent Bharatiyon ke paas masters ki degree hai, aur 2016 mein 48 percent Bharatiya-American Democrat hain. 70 percent Bharatiya-Americans ne Biden ko tarjeeh di, jabki H1B visa ka 70 percent Bharatiyon ke paas hai.

claims.claim_en: The number of Indians in America increased from 1,900,000 in 2000 to 3,982,000 by 2015.
claims.evidence_text: Uske baad se Piyush 'Bobby' Jindal aur Pramila Jayapal jaise kai log American pratinidhi sabha ke liye chune gaye. claims.claim_text: Pew Research ke mutabik, 40 percent Bharatiyon ke paas masters ki degree hai.
claims.claim_en: According to Pew Research, 40 percent of Indians have a master's degree.
claims.evidence_text: America mein Bharatiya log na sirf ek prabhavi apravasi samuh ke taur par hain balki doosre apravasi samuhon ki tulna mein inki shaikshanik prishthbhoomi bhi achhi hai. Think tank Pew Research Center ke mutabik America mein rehne wale 40 percent Bharatiyon ke paas masters ki degree hai aur Bharatiyon ki kul aabadi ka sirf 7.5 percent aabadi garibi rekha se neeche rah rahi hai jabki Americans ki 15.7 percent aabadi garibi rekha se neeche rahi hai.

Saal 2016 mein hue ek survey (NAAS post-election) se pata chalta hai ki 48 percent Bharatiya-American Democrat hain ya phir Democratic party ki or unka rujhan hai.
